O sensor de condutividade do processador: The water processor's conductivity sensor stopped working. Without it, the system cannot confirm recycled water is safe to drink and discards some as a precaution.

Sem o sensor, a base descarta água por p: Without the sensor, the base discards water as a precaution: recovery drops to 85% for 1 day.
O sistema de recuperação de água da ISS: The ISS water recovery system reached 98% reuse in 2023 with the Brine Processor Assembly. Conductivity sensors check purity before releasing drinking water.
A umidade relativa da estufa subiu para: Greenhouse relative humidity rose to 85%. With weak ventilation, fungi may attack the plants.
A umidade volta ao normal e a água conde: Humidity returns to normal and condensed water returns to the loop, as on the ISS.
Menos rega baixa a umidade, mas as plant: Less watering lowers humidity, but plants grow more slowly.
Fungo se espalhou: as plantas perderam m: Fungus spread: the plants lost half their growth.
Em 2016, zínias cultivadas no Veggie da: In 2016, zinnias grown in the ISS Veggie facility were attacked by mold due to excess humidity. Astronaut Scott Kelly adjusted watering and ventilation, saved some plants, and they bloomed.
A poeira levantada pelas EVAs cobriu os: Dust kicked up by EVAs covered the solar panels. Generation dropped to {poeira}% of normal.
Campos elétricos levantam a poeira sem t: Electric fields lift dust without touching the panel. Greater gain and continuous protection.
Limpa áreas específicas, mas exige EVA e: Cleans specific areas, but requires an EVA and consumes life support resources.
Dispensa EVA, mas é o método que mais ga: Requires no EVA, but uses the most power.
O Escudo Eletrodinâmico de Poeira (EDS): NASA's Electrodynamic Dust Shield (EDS) was demonstrated on the lunar surface in 2025 on the Blue Ghost 1 mission. NASA also researches the LEDM tool, and Glenn Research Center tested vibration to clean flexible panels. Apollo astronauts reported that lunar dust is as abrasive as ground glass.
O módulo 3 do rack de baterias chegou a: Battery rack module 3 reached 52 °C. Day 6 shade begins at MET 120 h and lasts 24 h.
Isolar o módulo e racionar na sombra: Isolate the module and ration power in the shade
Isolar evita a fuga térmica. Com o racio: Isolation prevents thermal runaway. With rationing, the base gets through the shade with a margin.
Uma célula de íon-lítio em fuga térmica: A lithium-ion cell in thermal runaway can set the entire rack on fire, right in the shade.
Entre 2017 e 2021, astronautas trocaram: Between 2017 and 2021, astronauts replaced the ISS's 48 nickel-hydrogen batteries with 24 lithium-ion batteries during EVAs. Lithium-ion batteries require strict thermal control: above a safe temperature, a cell can enter thermal runaway.
A pressão do Habitat cai 0,1 kPa por hor: Habitat pressure drops 0.1 kPa per hour. It is a small leak that is difficult to locate.
Localizar com detector ultrassônico e re: Locate with an ultrasonic detector and patch
O detector ultrassônico acha o ponto do: The ultrasonic detector locates the leak by the sound of escaping air.
Compensar com O₂ dos tanques: Compensate with O₂ from the tanks
Compensar gasta O₂ todo dia e o furo pod: Compensating uses O₂ every day, and the hole may grow. Patch it in the Habitat as soon as you can.
Em agosto de 2018 a tripulação da ISS no: In August 2018, the ISS crew noticed a pressure drop, found a 2 mm hole in Soyuz MS-09, and sealed it with epoxy and gauze. Since 2019, NASA has monitored a slow leak in the PrK tunnel of the Russian Zvezda module.
Os monitores detectaram partículas solar: Monitors detected solar particles. Ana and Bruno are on EVA. The peak arrives in 30 minutes.

No abrigo a parede absorve a maior parte: In the shelter, the wall absorbs most solar particles.
O traje equivale a só 2 g/cm². Ana e Bru: The suit provides only 2 g/cm². Ana and Bruno receive about 173 mSv, 70% of the 250 mSv limit per event.
Em agosto de 1972, entre as missões Apol: In August 1972, between Apollo 16 and 17, one of the largest solar storms ever recorded occurred. Astronauts on the lunar surface without shelter could have suffered acute radiation sickness. Today, satellites such as SOHO provide minutes to hours of warning.
O conjunto de destilação do processador: The urine processor's distillation assembly jammed. Without it, the base only recovers water from air condensate.
Com a destilação de volta, o ciclo de ág: With distillation restored, the water loop recovers 98% again.
Armazenar a urina e esperar a peça: Store urine and wait for the part
Armazenar a urina é seguro, mas a recupe: Storing urine is safe, but water recovery drops to 75% until the repair.
O processador de urina da ISS, instalado: The ISS urine processor, installed in 2008, experienced several distillation assembly failures over the years. Each replacement required parts from Earth, and the crew stored urine while waiting.
Oxigênio baixo no tanque de tilápia: Low oxygen in the tilapia tank
The main aquaponics aerator failed. Dissolved oxygen in the water is falling, and the tilapia are already surfacing.
O aerador de reserva mantém os peixes vi: The backup aerator keeps the fish alive. Closed systems need redundancy.
Abater parte da criação agora: Harvest some of the fish now
Menos peixes consomem menos oxigênio, ma: Fewer fish consume less oxygen, but the tank produces less food for the rest of the mission.
Sem oxigênio, metade das tilápias morreu: Without oxygen, half the tilapia died: aquaponics produces 50% less.
Peixes como a tilápia dependem do oxigên: Fish such as tilapia depend on dissolved oxygen: without aeration, a closed tank can lose its stock within hours. In 1998, the C.E.B.A.S. experiment took a closed ecosystem of fish and aquatic plants aboard the Space Shuttle.
O motor que gira os painéis para seguir: The motor that turns the panels to follow the Sun jammed. At the south pole, the Sun circles the horizon: stationary panels generate power only half the time.
Reparar o motor em EVA (2 × 3 h): Repair the motor on EVA (2 × 3 h)
O reparo devolve toda a geração antes do: The repair restores full generation before the day without sunlight, when the battery must be full.
Girar os painéis à mão a cada turno: Turn the panels by hand each shift
Girar à mão recupera parte da geração, m: Turning by hand restores some generation, but takes crew time several times a day.
No polo sul lunar o Sol fica rente ao ho: At the lunar south pole, the Sun stays near the horizon and circles the sky. That is why VSAT, the vertical solar array studied by NASA, rotates to track the Sun.
Um dos dois circuitos de amônia do contr: One of the two ammonia loops in thermal control is losing pressure. Day 6 shade begins at MET 120 h.
Isolar o circuito e racionar o calor: Isolate the loop and ration heat
Com um circuito só e a carga reduzida, o: With one loop and a reduced load, thermal control gets through day 6 without risking ammonia in the cabin.
Risco de perder o circuito na sombra: Risk of losing the loop in the shade
Se o circuito falhar na sombra, a base p: If the loop fails in the shade, the base loses heating on the coldest day.
Em maio de 2013 dois astronautas da ISS: In May 2013, two ISS astronauts performed an emergency EVA to contain an ammonia leak in the external thermal control loop.
O sistema de remoção de CO₂ do Habitat e: The Habitat's CO₂ removal system is saturating. Cabin CO₂ exceeded 4 mmHg, and the crew reports headaches.
Regenerar o leito devolve a capacidade d: Regenerating the bed restores removal capacity without using the emergency reserve.
Os cartuchos resolvem agora, mas a base: The cartridges solve the problem now, but the base has no reserve for a second failure.
O CO₂ ficou alto: dor de cabeça e cansaç: CO₂ remained high: headaches and fatigue throughout the crew.
Na Apollo 13 a tripulação adaptou os car: On Apollo 13, the crew adapted square LiOH cartridges to the lunar module's round fitting with tape and cardboard to avoid suffocating from CO₂. On the ISS, CDRA removes CO₂ using zeolite beds.
Partículas solares com a equipe no rover: Solar particles with the crew in the rover
Ana e Bruno estão no rover pressurizado: Ana and Bruno are in the pressurized rover 3 km from the base. The particle peak arrives in 30 minutes; returning takes 40.
Voltar correndo para o abrigo da base: Rush back to the base shelter
O pico chega antes deles: parte da viage: The peak arrives first: part of the trip is exposed, with little shielding.
O rover pressurizado tem cerca de 10 g/c: The pressurized rover has about 10 g/cm² of shielding: staying inside is better than crossing the surface at the peak.
A NASA LaRC calculou, para a tempestade: For the October 1989 storm, NASA LaRC calculated about 108 mSv inside a pressurized rover with 10 g/cm² of shielding, versus about 173 mSv in a suit (Clowdsley, 2021).
Ecos no Vácuo: impacto de micrometeoroid: Echoes in the Vacuum: micrometeoroid impact
Um micrometeoroide atingiu a infraestrut: A micrometeoroid hit the external infrastructure: it punctured a pressurized line and damaged the communications antenna. Isolate the compartment.
A ISS é atingida por micrometeoroides co: The ISS is frequently hit by micrometeoroids. Its modules use Whipple shields: thin, spaced layers that shatter the projectile before it reaches the hull. At the lunar south pole, NASA's LunaNet network plans relay satellites to maintain communications.
Sem a antena principal, os alertas de cl: Without the main antenna, space weather alerts and Earth calls use the slow backup channel.
0,7 kg de O₂ e dose de EVA: 0.7 kg of O₂ and EVA dose
Comunicação é o que avisa a base de temp: Communications warn the base about solar storms. It is worth the EVA cost.
Sem a antena, o aviso de uma tempestade: Without the antenna, solar storm warnings arrive late and the crew is isolated.
Em 2019 o satélite de relé chinês Queqia: In 2019, the Chinese Queqiao relay satellite enabled communication with the Chang'e 4 probe on the Moon's far side: without a relay, there is no direct line to Earth. NASA's LunaNet network follows the same idea for the south pole.
O impacto destruiu a baliza que dá posiç: The impact destroyed the beacon that provides positions to rovers and astronauts on EVA. Without it, every outing depends on visual navigation.
0,5 kg de O₂ e dose de EVA: 0.5 kg of O₂ and EVA dose
Com a baliza, as próximas EVAs voltam a: With the beacon, future EVAs regain predictable routes and durations.
No polo sul as sombras longas confundem: At the south pole, long shadows make terrain hard to read; without a beacon, each EVA takes longer.
A LunaNet da NASA prevê também serviços: NASA's LunaNet also plans navigation, positioning and time services for astronauts and rovers at the south pole, like a lunar GPS. Low-angle polar light creates long shadows that hinder visual navigation.
Carla e Diego discutiram sobre a divisão: Carla and Diego argued over task assignments. The atmosphere in the Habitat became tense.
Talk to Carla and Diego in the Habitat.
No experimento Mars-500 (2010–2011), sei: In the Mars-500 experiment (2010–2011), six volunteers spent 520 days isolated in Moscow. Several experienced sleep disturbances, and conflicts occurred.
No polo sul o Sol quase não se põe. Dieg: At the south pole, the Sun barely sets. Diego slept less than 4 h per night over the last 3 days.
Give Diego 6 h off duty in the Habitat.
Astronautas da ISS dormem em média cerca: ISS astronauts sleep about 6 h per night on average. In 2016, NASA replaced ISS lamps with adjustable-color LEDs to support circadian rhythms.
Ana recebeu a notícia de que a mãe foi h: Ana learned that her mother was hospitalized on Earth.
Faça a ligação pela LunaNet no console d: Make the LunaNet call at the Habitat console.
A NASA mantém apoio psicológico e confer: NASA provides psychological support and regular family conferences for ISS astronauts. On the Moon, communication delay is about 1.3 s each way.
